lines_of_business: Not stated on the document; Blue Shield of California members; contract language controls
effective_or_revised: Original 6/1/2018; page 1 header Effective December 1, 2025 (library metadata says 2024-12-01); policy history last row 12/01/2025
sections_in_order: Supplemental Information (Practice Guidelines, Medicare National Coverage)
criteria_location: Policy Statement p.1 (I.A-F and II) but the definitions of 'conservative therapy', K&L and Outerbridge, relative contraindications and the acute-injury exception are in Policy Guidelines pp.1-2 behind asterisk footnotes (*, **, ***). Documentation list p.9-10. Scope is narrow: degenerative tears and chondroplasty in OA only; other knee arthroscopy explicitly not addressed.
procedures_covered: Knee arthroscopy with arthroscopic partial meniscectomy/chondroplasty for degenerative tears in knee OA (CPT 29880, 29881)

logic.top_level: all (I.A-F) plus a separate not-medically-necessary rule (II)

k_of_n.quote: Conservative Treatment ... should have non-surgical treatment documented ... including all of the following, unless contraindicated

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: II: severe OA Grade 3 or 4 is NMN. I.D repeats it as a negative leaf. I.F: not for lavage/debridement with knee pain only. Relative contraindications (BMI>40, age<50) in footnote; they do not exclude, they require exhausting non-surgical options.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Kellgren & Lawrence or Outerbridge Grade 3 greater than 1.5cm or Grade 4
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Reads as K&L OR Outerbridge; which scale governs if they disagree is not said. 'Grade 3 greater than 1.5cm' attaches size to Outerbridge only. II says grade 3 or 4 on either scale, which is stricter than I.D (grade 3 >1.5 cm).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Underlying knee osteoarthritis, including degenerative tears of the meniscus in the setting of osteoarthritis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Requires OA as a condition for coverage, yet II denies severe OA; the covered window is mild/moderate OA that the policy never states positively.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: including all of the following, unless contraindicated: ... Weight reduction counseling as appropriate ... Therapeutic injections into the knee as appropriate
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'All of' plus 'as appropriate/optional' in the same list; an all-of that is partly optional.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: indicated without 6 weeks of conservative therapy in injuries caused by acute events, in the absence of osteoarthritis. These include non-degenerative meniscal tears leading to a locked knee, recurrent giving way, and/or amenable to repair
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or'; and these contradict I.A (OA required), so the acute pathway is outside the policy's own scope.

requirement_kinds.quote: Underlying knee osteoarthritis, including degenerative tears of the meniscus in the setting of osteoarthritis
Documentation of knee symptomatology, including history, physical exam (e.g., knee swelling/effusion and painful range of motion)
MRI radiological report with results and interpretation indicating meniscal tear
No evidence of severe osteoarthritis by radiographic imaging (weight-bearing plain films, MRI, and/or CT scan)
Documentation of unsuccessful conservative therapy for at least six weeks
Anti-inflammatory medications or analgesics; Activity modification; Supervised physical therapy ...; Weight reduction counseling as appropriate; Assistive device use; Therapeutic injections
The procedure is NOT for arthroscopic lavage and debridement for persons presenting with knee pain only
morbid obesity (body mass index [BMI] greater than 40), or age less than 50 years unless there are no other treatment options
Prior conservative treatments, duration, and response or reason conservative treatment is inappropriate
Modified Outerbridge scale Grade/K&L Scale Grade, as applicable

thresholds.quote: unsuccessful conservative therapy for at least six weeks
Outerbridge Grade 3 greater than 1.5cm or Grade 4
morbid obesity (body mass index [BMI] greater than 40)
age less than 50 years unless there are no other treatment options

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Only 29880 and 29881 listed; disclaimer says inclusion/exclusion of a code does not imply coverage.

external_dependencies.what: Medicare NCD 150.9 reproduced in Supplemental Information for context
external_dependencies.quote: According to the national coverage determination (NCD) for Arthroscopic Lavage and Arthroscopic Debridement for the Osteoarthritic Knee (150.9)
To the extent there are conflicts between this Medical Policy and the member health services contract language, the contract language will control.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: Fibrillation/fissuring with partial thickness cartilage loss or focal ulceration (>2mm or >50% cartilage depth without exposed bone). (MRI-partial thickness cartilage loss of >2mm ... >1.5cm)
Individuals with relative contraindications should exhaust all appropriate nonsurgical treatment options prior to surgical consideration.

vague_terms.quote: Supervised physical therapy which could include an instructed home exercise program
vague_terms.problem: 'Supervised' vs 'instructed home program' blurs; no visit count.

vague_terms.quote: unless there are no other treatment options for the individual

vague_terms.problem: 'May be considered', not 'is'; softer language than FL.

extraction_hazards: Footnote asterisks (*, **, ***) tie to text on pp.1-2, not beside the criteria
Page header/footer repeated on every page ('Reproduction without authorization...')
Appendix A is a before/after two-column redline table that duplicates the Policy Statement; a parser sees the criteria three times
Literature review on pp.4-9 contains numbers (WOMAC, BMI) that are not criteria
Library metadata effective date (2024-12-01) differs from the printed header (December 1, 2025)
interesting_structures: Narrow-scope policy: covers one indication, explicitly disclaims others
Relative contraindications that change workup requirements rather than exclude
Acute-injury exception that skips the 6-week requirement but is in a footnote

fit_to_tree.why: Short all-of with a not-leaf, but the conservative therapy checklist is defined in a footnote, the grade rule has two scales, and the acute exception lives in a footnote that contradicts the OA precondition.
